carbon_policy_signal.item: Poland court upholds seven major climate laws, rejecting bid to overturn EU ETS compliance and coal phase-out obligations.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Removes rollback risk on coal phase-out and ETS enforcement; supports EUA price floor and reduces downside tail on decarbonisation trajectory through 2030s.

freshness_caveat: Coal data stale (321 days old, as of 2025-12-26); disqualifies clean-dark spread and merit-order thermal dispatch analysis. DE Power and TTF unavailable; GB power and renewables current (1 day or less). Clean-spark and clean-dark calculations cannot proceed.
risk_flags: Renewables at 3rd-percentile of 5yr range with -58.6% monthly decline; thermal baseload floor not yet tested.
GB power at 93rd-percentile (195.26 EUR/MWh) vs EU DA unavailable; interconnector delay (EU-UK electricity deal pending) prolongs premium duration.
Storage 71.61% full, 17.5pp below seasonal trend; refill trajectory critical for winter power curve shape through Dec-Jan.
Coal data stale (321 days old, 8th-percentile); disqualifies clean-dark / merit-order analysis until refresh.

base.summary: Renewables stay subdued; thermal dispatch sustained; GB premium holds elevated; storage refill continues at trend pace.

downside.summary: Renewables extend tail below 10% load; thermal call peaks; Spain election win by climate-skeptic coalition delays coal phase-out.

upside.summary: Wind event lifts renewables +8–12pp; thermal call collapses 15–20%; GB spreads compress on interconnector progress news.

themes: GB power premium vs EU widening on tight capacity
Storage deficit extending into refill season
Climate policy cohesion tested by populist election cycle
top_drivers: Renewables collapse to 3rd-percentile forcing maximum thermal call; thermal baseload floor not yet visible on DA.
GB power premium (93rd-percentile, 195.26 EUR/MWh) reflects tight capacity and delayed interconnector agreement; spreads likely to widen further if wind stays depressed.
Storage deficit (17.5pp below seasonal) entering refill season; injection pace through Dec-Jan will anchor winter power curve and set H2 thermal dispatch baseline.
top_takeaway: Renewables at 3rd-percentile (13.18% load) force extreme thermal call; GB power at 93rd-percentile (195.26 EUR/MWh) signals tight capacity; storage 17.5pp below seasonal average underpins H2 refill risk.

watchlist.why: 3rd-percentile tail extends thermal call; next high-wind event could swing 5–10pp load share and 20–30 EUR/MWh DA.
GB at 93rd-percentile; EU-UK interconnector signing delays widen arbitrage opportunity and exacerbate GB scarcity premium.
71.61% vs 5yr seasonal +17.5pp deficit; Nov-Dec injection rate will set Jan power floor and Cal+1 risk.
Poland court upholds climate laws (bullish EUA); Spain election (late Nov) threatens EU coal phase-out consensus (bearish EUA); net tilt data-dependent.

watchlist_dated.name: Spain snap election — climate policy direction
watchlist_dated.why: Conservative victory could relax coal phase-out and renewable auction pace; bearish for EUA floor and power curve.

watchlist_dated.name: EU-UK electricity interconnector signing
watchlist_dated.why: Delays prolong GB-EU DA spread arbitrage; signature unlocks cross-border flattening and Cal+1 differential compression.
